fool.label: The Fool
fool.passive: No suit of its own, so no opposite: your tokens never take double damage. Once a turn, pay 2 to roll the Hungry Die again.

chariot.label: The Chariot
chariot.passive: Swords: your sword tokens advance one tile further, and your sword cards play one up or down. Every token of yours advances one tile further, takes 3 less from a hit, and wins a meeting unhurt.
chariot.does: Charge: your tokens fight and strike with 3 more power this turn.

empress.label: The Empress
empress.passive: Pentacles: your pentacle tokens advance one tile further, and your pentacle cards play one up or down. Tokens you place are one rank stronger (not faster).
empress.does: Bloom: every tile under one of your tokens turns yours.

hermit.label: The Hermit
hermit.passive: Cups: your cup tokens advance one tile further, and your cup cards play one up or down. You keep three cards between turns, not two.
hermit.does: Lantern: this turn's Hungry Die roll is 3 higher.

tower.label: The Tower
tower.passive: Wands: your wand tokens advance one tile further, and your wand cards play one up or down. Your tokens that fall are fed to your Hungry Die, not discarded.
tower.does: Lightning: every token on the board takes 3, yours too but your wands.
